name: Captain Mar-Vell, Space-Born
oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance
Cosmic Awareness — As long as an opponent has cast a spell this turn, you may cast spells as though they had flash.
blocked_sentences: Cosmic Awareness — As long as an opponent has cast a spell this turn, you may cast spells as though they had flash.

needs.what: the per-turn spell-cast ledger readable from a static ability's condition: `spells_cast_this_turn` (scoped to opponents) in `static_value_keys`, so a `cast_as_though_flash` static with affects_player "you" can carry condition `cmp` {spells_cast_this_turn: opponent} > 0 and switch on the moment any opponent casts a spell this turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `cast_as_though_flash` static already expresses the permission, but its `condition` may only use `static_condition_keys`/`static_value_keys`; `spells_cast_this_turn` is in `value_keys` (effects and triggers) and absent from `static_value_keys`, and no `has_turn_flag` style key exists for statics. A `spell_cast` trigger setting a flag would be an unprinted ability and would miss spells cast before this permanent entered
